memory: No automatic lane/candidate truncation on memory pressure. Pause operationally rather than changing science.
minimum_free_space: Check before every chunk, merge, release and catalog rebuild.
preflight_estimate: Compute attempts from exact parent/primitive port cardinalities before generation. Pause if the frozen attempt cap would be exceeded.
storage: Object-store deduplication is used; chain accounting counts newly materialized bytes and release bytes separately.
wall_time: Controller enforces per-level and total-chain wall limits at checkpoint boundaries.
